items.question: What kinds of coins do you grade?
items.answer: US and world coins from 1600 to the present, most tokens and medals, and ancient Roman and select Greek coins.

items.question: How much does grading cost?
items.answer: From $18 per coin, depending on the type of coin, its value and the service. Every tier is on the Fees and turnaround page. For coins worth over $7,500, call for pricing.

items.question: How long does grading take?
items.answer: 10 to 30 business days, depending on the service. Turnaround times are approximate and not guaranteed.

items.question: How do I ship my coins?
items.answer: Send the submission form first: we reply with a quote and the address to ship to. Coins travel at your risk, so insurance is recommended (1% of the order's total value), and orders over $750 need signature delivery.

items.question: Can I try you with a few coins first?
items.answer: Yes. A small trial submission is welcome, so you can see the grading, the holder and the label before you send more.

items.question: Can I choose the label?
items.answer: Every service includes a ready-made label design for US, world, Roman or Greek coins. A custom label design costs $100, and is free on orders of 200 coins or more.

items.question: Can I send coins already in another company's holder?
items.answer: Yes: a crossover costs the same as the service tier. A reholder into our holder is $5.

items.question: How can I check a certificate you issued?
items.answer: Use the Verify a certificate page and type the certificate number from the label. You'll see the coin, grade and photos we keep on record. If a number isn't found, contact us before buying or selling the coin.
